cluster_summary: A wide range of cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerabilities caused by failing to neutralize user-supplied data—either through HTML entity encoding, input sanitization, or input validation—before it is embedded in web pages. The cluster includes reflected, stored, and JSONP-based XSS, with fixes ranging from global input filters to per-field encoding and strict allowlist validation.
guideline_text: Trace attacker-influenced inputs, resource identities, state values, or configuration described by the member CVEs into the sensitive operation or security boundary described by the member CVEs. Report code paths where the required validation, authorization, isolation, state check, or binding is absent or not connected to the sensitive effect. Confirm that the guard is enforced before the sensitive effect and remains bound to the same resource, principal, destination, or object that the effect uses. Treat this as a reusable mechanism-level pattern derived from 1 historical CVE example(s), not as a project-specific signature. A safe implementation should Introduce a global servlet filter and AOP aspect that sanitize all request parameters using Jsoup.clean (or equivalent) before they reach any controller..
